title: Kernel and support description of a sheaf strict transform
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $Z\subseteq S$ be a closed subscheme [def-weil-closed-immersion] whose defining ideal is finite-type quasi-coherent [pqf-def-coherent], let $b:S'=\operatorname{Bl}_Z(S)\to S$ [def-nagata-global-blowup], and let $f:X\to S$ be a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme]. For a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module $\mathcal F$ [pqf-def-coherent], write $p:X\times_S S'\to X$ for the projection and $\mathcal F^{\mathrm{st}}$ for its module strict transform [def-trf-module-strict-transform]. The canonical map $p^*\mathcal F\twoheadrightarrow\mathcal F^{\mathrm{st}}$ is surjective; its kernel is the subsheaf of local sections supported on $(f\circ p)^{-1}(Z)$, and this kernel is a quasi-coherent submodule, so $\mathcal F^{\mathrm{st}}$ is a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_{X\times_SS'}$-module. Consequently the map is an isomorphism over the complement of that inverse image, and $\mathcal F^{\mathrm{st}}$ has no nonzero local sections supported on $(f\circ p)^{-1}(Z)$. When $\mathcal F=\mathcal O_X$, the kernel of $\mathcal O_{X\times_SS'}\twoheadrightarrow\mathcal O_X^{\mathrm{st}}$ is the ideal sheaf of the scheme strict transform $i:X'\hookrightarrow X\times_SS'$ of $X$ along $b$ relative to $U=S\setminus Z$ [def-nagata-strict-transform], so that $\mathcal O_X^{\mathrm{st}}\cong i_*\mathcal O_{X'}$ as quotients of $\mathcal O_{X\times_SS'}$.

proof.text: Put $Y=X\times_S S'$ with projections $p:Y\to X$ and $q:Y\to S'$, let $E=b^{-1}(Z)\subseteq S'$ (cut out by $\mathcal I\mathcal O_{S'}$, $\mathcal I$ the ideal of $Z$), and let $D=q^{-1}(E)=(f\circ p)^{-1}(Z)$. By [thm-nagata-blowup-principalizes-center], every point of $S'$ has an affine neighbourhood $V$ with $E\cap V=V(a)$ for one $a\in\mathcal O_{S'}(V)$; hence on an open of $Y$ mapping into $V$ the set $D$ is the zero set of the image of $a$. Let $W\subseteq Y$ be an affine open. Each point of $W$ has a principal open $D(g)\subseteq W$ mapping into such a $V$ ([lem-weil-pbc-affine-opens-basis] and the basic-open basis of [lem-weil-pbc-spec-localization-away-basic-open](i)), and on it $D=V(a_g)$; finitely many of them cover $W$ by [lem-weil-pbc-spec-basic-opens-unit-ideal-quasi-compact](iii). Thus $W\setminus D=\bigcup_g D(g)\cap D(a_g)$ is a finite union of principal opens, each quasi-compact as the homeomorphic image of the spectrum of a localization [lem-weil-pbc-spec-localization-away-basic-open](ii), [lem-weil-pbc-spec-basic-opens-unit-ideal-quasi-compact](iii). So the open immersion $j:Y\setminus D\hookrightarrow Y$ is quasi-compact; it is quasi-separated because, being a monomorphism, its diagonal is an isomorphism, hence quasi-compact [def-weil-quasi-separated-morphism].

source.place: Paragraph preceding Tag 080D: the exceptional divisor is effective Cartier, its inverse image is locally principal, and its complement is retrocompact.

proof.text: The pullback $H=p^*\mathcal F$ is quasi-coherent by [lem-weil-pbc-module-pullback-quasi-coherent]. Let $K\subseteq H$ be the subsheaf of sections restricting to zero on $Y\setminus D$; a section has support in $D$ exactly when its germs vanish off $D$, i.e. (sheaf axiom) when it restricts to zero on the complement, so $K$ is the subsheaf of sections supported on $D$. It is the sectionwise kernel of $H\to j_*(H|_{Y\setminus D})$, since $(j_*(H|_{Y\setminus D}))(W)=H(W\setminus D)$. The restriction $H|_{Y\setminus D}$ is the module pullback $j^*H$ (because $j^{-1}\mathcal O_Y=\mathcal O_{Y\setminus D}$), hence quasi-coherent by [lem-weil-pbc-module-pullback-quasi-coherent] applied to $j$, and $j_*$ preserves quasi-coherence by [pqf-lem-pushforward-qcoh] because $j$ is quasi-compact and quasi-separated by Step 1. Therefore $K$ is quasi-coherent by [lem-weil-pbc-quasi-coherent-module-kernel]. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-quasi-coherent-module-cokernel-image] to the inclusion $K\hookrightarrow H$: its cokernel $H/K$ is quasi-coherent by (2), the quotient map $\pi:H\to H/K$ is an epimorphism by (1), and its sectionwise kernel is $\operatorname{Im}(K\hookrightarrow H)$, which is $K$ itself because a section of $H$ that is locally in the sheaf $K$ lies in $K$. By [def-trf-module-strict-transform], $H/K$ is exactly $\mathcal F^{\mathrm{st}}$. So $\pi:p^*\mathcal F\twoheadrightarrow\mathcal F^{\mathrm{st}}$ is surjective with kernel $K$, the quasi-coherent subsheaf of sections supported on $D=(f\circ p)^{-1}(Z)$.

source.place: Tag 080D, paragraph preceding definition-strict-transform and clauses (1)--(2); Properties Tag 07ZP for quasi-coherence of supported sections.

proof.text: Over $Y\setminus D$ the subsheaf $K$ restricts to zero (a section of $K$ over an open $O\subseteq Y\setminus D$ restricts to zero on $O$ itself), so $\pi|_{Y\setminus D}$ is an epimorphism with zero kernel in the abelian category of $\mathcal O_{Y\setminus D}$-modules, hence an isomorphism. For the absence of supported sections, let $O\subseteq Y$ be open and $t\in\mathcal F^{\mathrm{st}}(O)$ with $t|_{O\setminus D}=0$. Cover $O$ by affine opens $W\subseteq O$ [lem-weil-pbc-affine-opens-basis]. By [lem-weil-pbc-quasi-coherent-module-cokernel-image](3) on the affine $W$, $t|_W=\pi_W(m)$ for some $m\in H(W)$. Then $\pi_{W\setminus D}(m|_{W\setminus D})=t|_{W\setminus D}=0$, so by part (1) of the same lemma (kernel of $\pi$ is $K$ on every open, Step 2) $m|_{W\setminus D}\in K(W\setminus D)=0$. Hence $m$ restricts to zero off $D$, i.e. $m\in K(W)$, and $t|_W=\pi_W(m)=0$. By the sheaf axiom $t=0$. This holds on every open $O$, so $\mathcal F^{\mathrm{st}}$ has no nonzero local section supported on $D$. (Algebraically, on $W=\operatorname{Spec}A$ with $D\cap W=V(I)$, $I$ finitely generated, this is the fact that $M/\Gamma_I(M)$ has no $I$-power torsion, the Tag 07ZP description; the argument above does not need that description.)

source.place: Tag 080D definition (1); the vanishing of supported sections of the quotient is not stated there and is written out here from the affine cokernel description (compare Properties Tag 07ZP(2), properties.tex lemma-sections-supported-on-closed-subset, and the charts in the proof of Tag 080E).

proof.text: For $\mathcal F=\mathcal O_X$, the pullback $p^*\mathcal O_X$ identifies canonically with $\mathcal O_Y$ by [lem-weil-pbc-module-pullback-structure-sheaf]; under it $K$ becomes the subsheaf $\mathcal K_0\subseteq\mathcal O_Y$ of functions restricting to zero on $Y\setminus D$, a quasi-coherent ideal by Step 2. Put $U=S\setminus Z$; the closed immersion $Z\to S$ has finite-type quasi-coherent ideal, so $Z$ is a finite-presentation centre as [def-nagata-strict-transform] requires. Since $b^{-1}(U)=S'\setminus E$, the universal property of fibre products [def-pc-fibre-product] identifies $(X\times_SU)\times_U(S'\times_SU)$ with $X\times_S b^{-1}(U)=q^{-1}(S'\setminus E)=Y\setminus D$, an open subscheme of $Y$, the map to $Y=X\times_SS'$ being the open immersion $j$, which is quasi-compact and quasi-separated by Step 1. By [def-nagata-strict-transform] and [def-nagata-scheme-theoretic-closure], $X'$ is the scheme-theoretic image of $j$, which by [def-nagata-scheme-theoretic-image] is the closed subscheme defined by $\ker(\mathcal O_Y\to j_*\mathcal O_{Y\setminus D})$; on an open $W$ this map is the restriction $\mathcal O_Y(W)\to\mathcal O_Y(W\setminus D)$, so the kernel is $\mathcal K_0$. Thus $i:X'\hookrightarrow Y$ is the closed immersion cut out by the quasi-coherent ideal $\mathcal K_0$ [lem-weil-pbc-quasi-coherent-ideal-closed-subscheme], whose ideal sheaf $\ker(\mathcal O_Y\to i_*\mathcal O_{X'})$ [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf] is $\mathcal K_0$, and $\mathcal O_Y\to i_*\mathcal O_{X'}$ is surjective [def-weil-closed-immersion]. An epimorphism with kernel $\mathcal K_0$ is a cokernel of $\mathcal K_0\hookrightarrow\mathcal O_Y$, so $\mathcal O_X^{\mathrm{st}}=\mathcal O_Y/\mathcal K_0\cong i_*\mathcal O_{X'}$ compatibly with the two quotient maps from $\mathcal O_Y$.

lean.statement: theorem moduleStrictTransform_properties {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (I : S.IdealSheafData) [I.toModules.IsFiniteType] (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] : Epi (moduleStrictTransformπ f I F) ∧ (∀ (V : (Limits.pullback f I.blowupMap).Opens) (s : Γ((tensorPullback (pullback.fst f I.blowupMap)).obj F, V)), (moduleStrictTransformπ f I F).app V s = 0 ↔ (moduleStrictTransformRestriction f I F).app V s = 0) ∧ (moduleStrictTransformKernel f I F).IsQuasicoherent ∧ (moduleStrictTransform f I F).IsQuasicoherent ∧ IsIso ((restrictFunctor (moduleStrictTransformOpen f I).ι).map (moduleStrictTransformπ f I F)) ∧ (∀ (V : (Limits.pullback f I.blowupMap).Opens) (s : Γ(moduleStrictTransform f I F, V)), ((restrictAdjunction (moduleStrictTransformOpen f I).ι).unit.app (moduleStrictTransform f I F)).app V s = 0 → s = 0)
